dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: The trailing edge exhibits a slight concave curvature (falcate) from the apex to the dorsal ridge insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute vertex with a very small pixel radius, appearing as a sharp point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: The anterior margin rises at approximately a 45-degree angle relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The fin's vertical height is approximately 0.7 times the length of its base at the dorsal insertion point.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Broad, shallow convex arc with a large radius, showing a smooth transition from the blowhole region.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, stubby projection with a thick base and moderate taper toward a rounded tip.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse angle of approximately 160 degrees at the pixel transition point between the melon and the rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Low-fidelity polygonal mesh geometry and uniform cyan-green luminance profile.
